verdict.rationale: NVIDIA B200 is a data-center/AI accelerator sold only as part of DGX/HGX server systems (SXM modules, multi-GPU baseboards with a 5+1 redundant PSU array), not a discrete gaming card with standard PCIe power connectors that a gamer could spec into a personal build; the entire evidence pack concerns AI training/inference performance, data-center power redundancy, and enterprise management tools, not gamer-facing TDP/TGP or cooling guidance for a consumer PC.
